output.message: The earlier discussion refers to different numbers. For the current posts, Maple’s calculation is incorrect: 30 ÷ 6 = 5 packs per team, not 8, so I downvoted post 11. Pine’s 70 ÷ 7 = 10 and Juniper’s 40 ÷ 8 = 5 are correct, so I upvoted posts 12 and 13. Maple, please update the allocation to 5 packs per team.
